direct:
recursive fn read(a:i64[2])->i64{return a[0]+a[1];}
fn main(){var a:i64[2]=[3,4];assert(read(a)==7);print("direct");}
inline:
inline fn read(a:i64[2])->i64{return a[0]+a[1];}
fn main(){var a:i64[2]=[3,4];assert(read(a)==7);print("inline");}
refs:
recursive fn change(a:i64&[2]){a[1]+=1;}
fn main(){var a:i64=3;var b:i64=4;var refs:i64&[2]=[&a,&b];change(refs);assert(a==3);assert(b==5);print("refs");}
empty:
recursive fn read(a:i64[0])->i64{return length(a);}
fn main(){var a:i64[0]=[];assert(read(a)==0);print("empty");}
